scripts.dev: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.mkdirSync('../dist',{recursive:true})" && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm --prefix .. run build && wrangler deploy --var DEV_AUTH:false --var ALLOWED_ORIGIN:https://soundly-api.akashkumar48874.workers.dev
